recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. The current core specification already supports multiple organization aliases and alias name search, while the historical standard extension was intentionally superseded by the core element.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification PA issue for Initial Draft/DSTU1 noting that Organization.name allowed only one value and asking for support for multiple names, aliases, translations, or variants. The recorded resolution was that the standard extension "alias" had been added.
initial_application: Git commit bf00335915ed7f0e22ec5fa03e2a306f3418fa4f explicitly applied tracker 3496 by adding the Organization alias standard extension and an example. That historical extension surface is no longer active current core source.
additional_context: Later PA decisions moved the capability into the core resource. FHIR-9625 added Organization.alias as a 0..* string and included aliases in Organization name search. FHIR-13345 later removed the now-redundant Organization and Location alias standard extensions and is already represented on the combined branch by commit 1c8eb12b4d7792aec840f7c4149d8654e6343969. FHIR-14834 confirmed abbreviations can be represented in Organization.alias and found through name search. A 2016 Zulip committers thread also records PA's intent to remove Organization.alias and Location.alias standard extensions because they were now core properties.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Organization is active in source/fhir.ini; source/organization/structuredefinition-Organization.xml has Organization.name at 0..1 and Organization.alias at 0..* for alternate or historic names; and source/organization/bundle-Organization-search-params.xml searches Organization.name | Organization.alias.
